title: Abortion, Spontaneous (Early Pregnancy Loss)—Cats
normalized_title: abortion spontaneous early pregnancy loss cats

content_blocks.text: Abortion: loss of a pregnancy at any time prior to the fetus’s ability to survive outside
Early pregnancy loss: loss of a pregnancy and death of conceptus within the first half of gestation
Infectious causes—direct infection of embryo, uterus, placenta, or fetuses, or indirectly by systemic infection.
Other systems resulting in debilitating illness.
Higher incidence in purebred or closed research catteries with closely related individuals; heritability of susceptibility to feline infectious peritonitis virus (FIPV) suspected to be high.
Difficult to determine, as pregnancy may not be diagnosed early. Loss or resorption of one or two conceptus within a litter is not uncommon.
Increased incidence in queens >5 years old; increased risk in purebred cats with high inbreeding.
